title: Golden and blue hour
summary: Which light you get at each sun height.

blocks.text: Light depends on how high the sun is, not on the clock. The phases come in this order every evening, and backwards every morning.

blocks.text: Times are for central Europe. Phases stretch in summer and the further north you go; near the equator they're much shorter.

items: Use an app such as PhotoPills or Sun Surveyor, or timeanddate.com, for exact times where you are.
Arrive 30 minutes early. The best colour often comes just after the sun has gone.
